notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187156/b6d7fb3d9d98d3ce637f4fb054ef0232c7cf3549.jpg[/img]

Today we want to share with you our new program: [u]𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐏𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐠𝐮𝐞𝐬𝐞/𝐁𝐫𝐚𝐳𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐧![/u] We are looking for players who are fluent in Portuguese who could participate in this project. 

[h3]✅ What you will do:[/h3]
- Collaborate with us to translate the game files into Portuguese
- Be part of a translator team
- Report your progress weekly 
- Learn more about gaming translation and how it works
- Bring your favorite game to more people from your country!

[h3]✅ Below are the requirements : [/h3]
- Great English level
- Lot of available time to do the translation
- Good teamwork skills
- Fluent in Portuguese/Brazilian
- Good knowledge of the game

If you are interested, please fill the form at this link with all your information so we can recontact you! 
➡ Full Project Information: https://bit.ly/3qwykH8
➡ Application form: https://bit.ly/3n6IonS
[b]*Form link will be closed on 11/18 at 6.PM (UTC +8)[/b]

notes.title: Official Release TODAY!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187156/3f563ecca9ce7d6210a365b510c3736b5757701e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Exclusive costumes to represent 8 countries at launch![/h1]

The game has been optimized to offer a great moment in an unforgettable adventure. It will fit all types of players, from casual ones to the most hardcore gamers! Don’t miss out on the official release to claim your exclusive rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187156/f2bc65bf23857f487a5f0b6336e17115bf7aa3dc.jpg[/img]


[h2]Celebrate the game’s launching with Halloween special event![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187156/04d4e66c5594fde2144db9f49a6119a7b9d5a359.jpg[/img]

A cute and quirky Halloween-themed event where you can redeem Halloween rewards by completing certain tasks each day! Trick or treat! (But the Sprites will still trick you even if you give them a treat!). 
There's also a wide range of themed weapons and equipment, so this Halloween is all about dressing up and messing around!


After completing the tutorial, you will also receive an SSR Memory Card to help the Sprite Messengers in their battles. Leveled packs will also be available to help you protect your home in Sprite lands! 
As you become more familiar with the game, your overall strength, equipment, and level will rise, so join the training and take away the goodies!


Cannot wait to meet you all in-game!

notes.title: Sprite Fantasia - Official Release will be on 10/19!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187156/637a2a47a4db21ff993a9b1173895a84a440359d.jpg[/img]

Pre-registration is in its final stages and the game has already reached 1000k pre-registrations! 
Don't miss your last chance to get an exclusive outfit, so you can make a glamorous appearance in the game!
This much-awaited game [b]will be available for download on 10/18 and will be officially launched on 10/19.[/b] 
The whole vast world of Saphael awaits you on your phone! Everyone is looking forward to meeting all the Sprites in this fantasy world! Are you ready to join in?

[h1]Sprite Fantasia Pre-Download Date:[/h1]

[list]
[*] 10/18 12:00 (UTC+8)
[*] 10/18 12:00 (UTC+1)
[*] 10/18 12:00 (UTC-5)
[/list]

Do you remember the wacky and hilarious Grand Fantasia? More is incoming, with additional gameplay varieties to boot! Players can use their Sprite companions to build a variety of special buildings and to craft a wide range of accessories to dress up in style!  


[h2]Equip Memory Cards - Create various tactical combinations[/h2]
Sprite Memory Cards have a variety of abilities that can be added to your equipment to give you an edge in battle. 
By making use of the combinations of effects and attributes of the cards, you can create [b]a variety of fighting styles, and some of the special cards can bring additional skills.[/b] 

If you want to increase your attack or be an indestructible shield for your companions, you can mix and match any of the many different combinations to customize your play style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187156/5e9ae96174ebe56a4729cf04469049251e89d599.jpg[/img]

[h3]Design the  Sprite Island of your dreams[/h3]
As a Sprite Messenger, it is only natural to have a Sprite Island! With the opening of the "Sprite Island" feature, players can go directly to their own Sprite Island by using the main menu at any time. 

Don't forget to decorate your home and show it off to your guildies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187156/b949c45b067c6d803cc2832f06c616b1ed02a095.jpg[/img]


For more information:
Pre-Registration Event: https://www.x-legend.com/spritefantasia/event/register/ 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SpriteFantasiaglobal
Discord: https://discord.gg/y6Hjv9mE22

notes.notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187156/5f7bfea6596d9cbb2ea1ebe0e0257deeae028242.jpg[/img]
Sprite Fantasia has opened for pre-registration on 9/10 and has reached the [b]500k milestone[/b] while being highly praised by players globally. There will be rewards at the game launch for all players who pre-registered! You can go on the pre-registration website to create your own Sprite, invite your friends to receive even more rewards like exclusive Sprite Cards! This will give you a lead right from the get-go! Invite more Sprite Messengers to join your journey to have fun playing together! This is the MMORPG that you can’t miss this year!

[h2]4 Major Classes, Great Transfer System for a unique set of skills!
[/h2]


● Long range cover and accurate sniping：[b]Archer[/b]
Complements the bow with various arrow ammunition in battle. Tactical mastery allows for battle across all environments and against any enemy.

Class Transfer－[b]Ranger[/b]
A tactical master of explosives, poison and smoke. Not even the enemy's best-laid plans can stem this strategic barrage.

Class Transfer－[b]Assassin[/b]
Adept at skulking in the shadows, patiently awaiting the enemy's guard to drop before administering a final stroke of death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187156/55050127f62bd1a6ba3896d43c8b4b1c8d8254f0.png[/img]


● All-round boosting with divine power：[b]Mage[/b]
Possessing unwavering faith, and able to perform all sorts of miracles and blessings to heal or buff allies. Also borrows divine strength to ward off evil.

Class Transfer－[b]Cleric[/b]
Borrows divine power through devoted faith to unleash powerful blessings and restorative magic.

Class Transfer－[b]Sage[/b]
A disciple of nature who, through special ritualistic means, has earned the graces of Mother Nature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187156/fb3db0c5a8f3194b5157e3572ec67bc00aeef050.png[/img]
